up: Retrieve the ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for all compounds that have activity data against the target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1293227 (human ubiquitin carboxyl-terminal hydrolase 2). Join the activities table with the target_dictionary to filter by the specific target ID, and join with compound_structures to obtain the canonical SMILES. Return distinct rows to avoid duplicates if a compound has multiple activity entries for the same target.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293227'
